data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a favourable movement in prior years' technical provisions of GBP 27.8m in 2016 (a release of reserves, approximately 6.3% of opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 441.4m). The report attributes this to favourable movement in technical provisions (favourable claims development). No specific named prior-year loss events are identified in the movement note.

data.data_quality_notes: The 'Favourable movement in technical provisions GBP 27.8m' figure is presented in the Prior years' claims provision note but the note excerpt in the scanned pages appears as a single aggregated figure without an explicit 'Insurance liabilities (gross)' column heading. It is therefore recorded here as the prior year movement with medium confidence (0.5). A gross claims development triangle is present in the report (page 25) but the scanned images do not clearly show all development-period rows needed to compute a gross PYD from the triangle; hence the PYD was taken from the prior years' claims provision note. Opening gross claims outstanding (441.4) is explicit in the provision reconciliation (page 24) and recorded with high confidence.

_claims_triangle.notes: A gross claims development table / analysis appears on page 25 (shows gross ultimate losses and gross claims liabilities by underwriting year). However the scanned images do not clearly present the full set of development-period rows (e.g. 'At end of underwriting year', 'One year later', etc.) in a reliably extractable format. Development rows left empty for data quality reasons.
